note: roles prune and score; they never decide alone (the solver verifies). An unknown name has no roles.

role_vocabulary.PAYLOAD: creature payload: a creature with mana value >= 6 (route-library cheat rule min_mv 6)
role_vocabulary.PAYLOAD_ARTIFACT: artifact payload: a nonland artifact with mana value >= 5 (route-library Tinker rule min_mv 5)
role_vocabulary.GY_ENABLER: puts a card of ours from library or hand into our graveyard (union of TUTOR_GY, DISCARD_OUTLET, SELF_MILL, GY_SELF)
role_vocabulary.TUTOR_GY: searches our library for a card and puts it into our graveyard (Entomb, Buried Alive)
role_vocabulary.DISCARD_OUTLET: we discard card(s) of our choice (or our whole hand): a discard cost, a loot, a wheel (costs.DISCARD_OUTLET = activation mana)
role_vocabulary.SELF_MILL: mills our own library (random, not routed)
role_vocabulary.GY_SELF: [extension] the card can put itself from hand into the graveyard (cycling / typecycling; costs.GY_SELF)
role_vocabulary.REANIMATE: puts a creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield (no mana-value limit)
role_vocabulary.CHEAT: puts a creature card from our hand onto the battlefield (Sneak Attack, Show and Tell, Through the Breach; costs.CHEAT = activation)
role_vocabulary.CHEAT_LIBRARY: [extension] puts a creature card from our library onto the battlefield without a mana-value limit (Natural Order); 'finds' is its filter
role_vocabulary.TINKER: sacrifices an artifact to put an artifact from our library onto the battlefield
role_vocabulary.ARTIFACT_FODDER: a cheap artifact (mana value <= 2, artifact lands included) to sacrifice
role_vocabulary.DOOMSDAY: builds an ordered pile from library + graveyard and exiles the rest
role_vocabulary.WINCON_EMPTY_LIBRARY: wins with an empty (or small) library: Thassa's Oracle, Laboratory Maniac, Jace, Wielder of Mysteries
role_vocabulary.DRAW: an instant/sorcery that draws >= 2 cards ('dig' = cards seen)
role_vocabulary.CANTRIP: a cheap instant/sorcery that draws 1 (or digs) ('dig' = cards seen)
role_vocabulary.ESCAPE_ENGINE: lets us cast cards from our graveyard (Underworld Breach, Yawgmoth's Will, Past in Flames)
role_vocabulary.FREE_MANA: one-shot net-positive mana: LED, Lotus Petal, Black Lotus, rituals, spirit guides ('mana' gives net and colours)
role_vocabulary.STORM_KILL: a storm spell that damages, drains or mills a player (Brain Freeze, Grapeshot, Tendrils of Agony)
role_vocabulary.UNTAPPER: a creature whose ETB untaps (or blinks) a permanent (Pestermite, Deceiver Exarch, Zealous Conscripts, Restoration Angel)
role_vocabulary.COPY_ENABLER: makes a hasty token copy by tapping (Splinter Twin, Kiki-Jiki)
role_vocabulary.TUTOR_ANY: searches our library for ANY card to our hand
role_vocabulary.TUTOR_HAND: searches our library for a restricted card to our hand ('tutor' gives the filter)
role_vocabulary.TUTOR_TOP: searches our library for a card and puts it on top ('tutor' gives the filter)
role_vocabulary.TUTOR_BF: searches our library for a restricted card onto the battlefield (GSZ, Eldritch Evolution...)
role_vocabulary.MANA:W|U|B|R|G|C: produces that colour (land, rock, dork, ritual or one-shot; 'mana' gives kind/amount/colours)

route_semantics: slots in execution order; zones: hand (in hand by that turn, drawn or tutored), library (not yet drawn), battlefield, graveyard; pay: cast (mana cost when cast from hand/graveyard), use (costs[role]), cast+use, none; roles: all required; filter_by: the slot whose card's 'finds' filter this card must pass
